issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְחֵקֶר כְּבֹדָם כָּבוֹד' means 'and searching out their glory is glory' (i.e., seeking the honor/glory of others is honorable). The Vietnamese 'tìm cách tự huyễn hoặc mình lại gây tổn hại' means 'seeking to delude oneself causes harm', which is a different concept—it introduces self-deception and harm not present in the Hebrew, and omits the idea of glory/honor as the object and result.
